title: acinos alpinus f. hirsutus
intro: Acinos alpinus f. hirsutus, commonly known as alpine thyme or mountain thyme, is a subspecies of the Acinos alpinus plant, belonging to the Lamiaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe respiratory issues, such as coughs and colds, and support the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Acinos alpinus f. hirsutus include acting as an expectorant, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory agent, which can help to relieve congestion and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
